site.name: weaveapi
site.summary: weaveapi-clone Fictional payments API platform "WeaveAPI" developer docs (Stripe-style). Pages (shared docs three-column layout: left nav / center body / right try-it or anchors) | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Docs home: Quickstart, Authentication, Idempotency, Pagination, Errors sections + Popular guides 4 cards | | `quickstart.html` | Install + first-charge two-step example | | `charges.html` | Charges API: Charge object 18-field table + 5 endpoint sections (POST create / GET single / capture / refund / list), each section with parameter table + multi-lang code block + JSON response example; right-column try-it panel syncs with the current endpoint as you scroll, fill params + Send returns a mock response (`currency=usd/eur/gbp/jpy` returns a charge object, anything else returns `currency_not_supported`) |

run_plan.goal: Explore the full WeaveAPI docs experience end-to-end, validating the primary developer onboarding flow from home to Quickstart to API reference, while also checking adjacent reference pages, navigation patterns, interactive code/examples, mock try-it states, and responsive usability.
run_plan.summary: Start on the docs home and verify the core information architecture: left nav, on-page anchors, search field presence, theme toggle, code language tabs, and popular guide links. Then follow the main onboarding path into Quickstart and Charges, where the deepest interaction surface exists via endpoint sections and the try-it panel with both success and error responses. Finish by covering Customers, Webhooks, and Errors as adjacent reference flows, then repeat the most important navigation and readability checks on mobile because the prescan already shows small tap targets and some horizontal overflow risk.
assumptions: The six known HTML pages are the full documentation set to cover in this run: index.html, quickstart.html, charges.html, customers.html, webhooks.html, and errors.html.
The shared docs shell likely repeats across pages, including left navigation, a search input, a theme toggle, code language tabs, and code copy controls.

charges.html contains the richest interactive behavior and should be treated as the highest-priority validation page because the prescan explicitly mentions a scroll-synced try-it panel and mock response logic based on currency input.
Customers and Webhooks appear primarily informational/reference-oriented unless deeper interactivity is revealed during execution.
Mobile usability is a meaningful risk area because the prescan flagged repeated small tap targets across pages and horizontal overflow on charges.html, customers.html, and webhooks.html.
risk_hotspots: charges.html try-it panel: endpoint sync while scrolling may desync from visible section
charges.html try-it Send action: validate supported currency success states and unsupported currency error state
charges.html parameter inputs and JSON/code examples: risk of clipped content or confusing mapping between inputs and response
charges.html horizontal overflow flagged in prescan, especially around tables, code blocks, and right-column panel
customers.html horizontal overflow flagged in prescan, likely from object tables or code blocks
webhooks.html horizontal overflow flagged in prescan, likely from event tables or signature examples
Shared left navigation links at 31px height: repeated small tap target risk on mobile
Search docs input: visible on all pages but no prescan evidence of results behavior, so verify affordance and any lightweight interaction without assuming full search
Theme toggle (🌙): shared global control worth checking for state persistence/visual consistency
Code language tabs and Copy buttons on index.html and reference pages: ensure tab switching and copy affordances are understandable and non-breaking

phases.title: Home page orientation and global shell
phases.objective: Validate the top-level docs IA and the shared controls from the landing page before branching into deeper content.

Use right-side 'On this page' anchors to confirm in-page navigation to Quickstart, Authentication, Idempotency, Pagination, and Errors
Check the search input for focus behavior, placeholder clarity, and whether typing triggers any visible state without assuming a full search system exists
Toggle theme via the moon button and confirm the page visibly changes and remains legible
Switch among visible code language tabs (CURL, PYTHON, NODE, GO) in at least one section and verify content changes coherently
Use at least one Copy control to confirm it is actionable and gives feedback if any
Open each Popular guides card/link destination path from the home page
exit_criteria: Home page anchors, nav, search field, theme toggle, and at least one code block interaction have all been exercised
Destinations for Quickstart, Charges, Customers, Webhooks, and Errors have been confirmed reachable from index.html

phases.title: Primary onboarding flow
phases.objective: Follow the main developer learning path from Quickstart into the core payments reference, checking whether the docs tell a coherent story and support fast first success.
key_checks: On quickstart.html, verify the two-step flow is understandable: install SDK, then make first charge
Exercise code language tabs and copy controls on Quickstart to see whether examples stay aligned with the step context
Follow any read-on links from Quickstart into Charges or Webhooks to confirm flow continuity
On charges.html, verify section structure covers Charge object, create, retrieve, capture, refund, and list
Use in-page navigation and scrolling to check whether the active endpoint context and right-column try-it panel stay synchronized
Confirm that moving between endpoint sections updates the visible try-it content appropriately
exit_criteria: A user could plausibly move from landing page to Quickstart to Charges without dead ends or confusing transitions
Charges page endpoint sections and try-it synchronization behavior have been observed across multiple sections

phases.title: Charges interaction and recovery states
phases.objective: Deeply validate the highest-risk interactive page by testing realistic happy-path and error-path inputs in the try-it experience.
key_checks: Use the Create charge try-it with a supported currency (usd, eur, gbp, or jpy) and verify a mock charge object response appears
Repeat with an unsupported currency value to confirm the documented/mock error path returns currency_not_supported
Check whether endpoint-specific inputs, labels, and defaults make sense for create, retrieve, capture, refund, and list sections
Verify response examples remain readable and do not visually collide with parameter tables or the right rail
Cross-check that code examples, parameter tables, and try-it fields are semantically aligned for at least create and one non-create endpoint
Note any friction in editing fields, submitting, or understanding what changed after Send
exit_criteria: At least one success state and one failure state have been triggered in the try-it panel
Most visible controls on charges.html have been exercised, including endpoint changes, inputs, Send, code tabs, and copy where present

phases.title: Adjacent API and reference coverage
phases.objective: Cover the secondary docs flows to assess consistency, completeness, and cross-page navigation quality beyond the primary payments path.
key_checks: On customers.html, verify the object table and the endpoint sections for create, retrieve, update, delete, and list are discoverable and internally consistent
Exercise any visible code tabs/copy controls on customers.html and compare shell consistency with charges.html
On webhooks.html, verify anchor navigation to Event types, Verifying signatures, and Retries from the left nav and/or right-side anchors if present
Inspect the readability of the event list and signature/retry guidance, especially where long examples may overflow
On errors.html, confirm the error table/reference is scannable and that the handling guidance is understandable
Traverse between these pages using shared nav to confirm users can move among reference areas without losing orientation
exit_criteria: Customers, Webhooks, and Errors pages have all been visited and their main sections inspected
Cross-page shell consistency and navigation continuity have been assessed across all secondary reference pages

phases.title: Responsive and mobile-focused validation
phases.objective: Recheck the most important flows and known risk areas on mobile, focusing on navigation, overflow, and touch usability.
key_checks: On mobile viewport, verify whether the shared navigation remains accessible and whether users can still reach all major pages and sections
Specifically inspect the small-tap-target links in the left nav or any collapsed equivalent navigation for usability
Revisit index.html to confirm search, theme toggle, and at least one code block remain usable on smaller screens
Revisit charges.html to inspect horizontal overflow in code blocks, tables, and the try-it panel, and retry one happy-path submission on mobile if possible
Spot-check customers.html and webhooks.html for the overflow warnings seen in prescan
Confirm that right-rail/on-page navigation patterns degrade gracefully or remain discoverable on mobile
exit_criteria: Critical desktop findings have been either reproduced or cleared on mobile for index.html and charges.html
Known mobile risks from prescan—small tap targets and overflow—have been explicitly evaluated on the flagged pages

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 6 known HTML pages, with repeated deeper passes on index.html and charges.html.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise the shared shell controls on multiple pages (search field presence/interaction, theme toggle, code language tabs, copy buttons), use in-page anchors where available, and fully test the charges try-it with both supported and unsupported currency inputs.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical navigation, code-block readability, theme/search access, and the core Charges try-it check on mobile; spot-check all pages for tap target and overflow issues, prioritizing index.html, charges.html, customers.html, and webhooks.html.

notes: Do not assume backend-backed search, persistence, authentication, or real API calls beyond the mock try-it behavior explicitly described in the prescan.

Because the site is documentation-heavy, critique should emphasize discoverability, scanability, consistency of examples, and whether code, tables, anchors, and right-rail patterns support a developer workflow.

prescan_summary.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https:
headings: Accept your first payment in 5 minutes.

prescan_summary.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url

prescan_summary.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.

observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/capture -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=1500 Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/refund -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=500 Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl "https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges?customer=cus_abc&limit=10" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. Recompute the HMAC over "<t>.<body>" using your webhook signing secret and constant-time compare. CURL PYTHON NODE GO # verify via openssl + sha256 echo -n "$timestamp.$body" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$WEBHOOK_SECRET" Copy Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler. ON THIS PAGE Event types Verifying signatures Retries

observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url currency_not_supported 400 Currency not enabled on account Enable currency in dashboard amount_too_small 400 Below minimum charge amount Increase amount (min $0.50 USD) amount_too_large 400 Above per-transaction maximum Split the charge missing_required_param 400 Required parameter omitted Check the error param invalid_param 400 Parameter value was invalid See param and message resource_missing 404 No such resource Check the ID resource_already_exists 409 Duplicate idempotency key with different params Use a new idempotency key authentication_required 401 Missing or invalid API key Send Authorization: Bearer sk_… permission_denied 403 API key lacks scope Grant scope in dashboard rate_limited 429 Too many requests Back off; respect Retry-After account_inactive 403 Account is closed or suspended Contact support refund_too_large 400 Refund exceeds refundable amount Check amount_refunded charge_already_captured 400 Charge was already captured No action needed charge_already_refunded 400 Charge fully refunded No action needed customer_max_payment_methods 400 Cannot attach more methods (limit 25) Detach unused methods idempotency_key_in_use 409 Key in use for in-flight request Wait and retry the same key invalid_webhook_signature 400 Webhook HMAC didn't match Check signing secret service_unavailable 503 Temporary outage Retry with backoff; check status page

observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB \ -u sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc: Copy Idempotency Every state-changing request accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. Pagination List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. has_more tells you when you've reached the end; next_cursor is the opaque token for the next page. Errors WeaveAPI returns conventional HTTP status codes plus a structured error object with type, code, and message. Full list → Popular guides Charges API → Create, capture, list, refund. Customers API → Save methods, manage profiles. Webhooks → Listen for events, sign requests. Error reference → 25+ error codes with hints. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. Recent (last 3)

observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. Recompute the HMAC over "<t>.<body>" using your webhook signing secret and constant-time compare. CURL PYTHON NODE GO import crypto from "node:crypto"; function verify(payload, header, secret, tolerance = 300) { const [t, sig] = header.split(",").map(p => p.split("=")[1]); if (Math.abs(Date.now()/1000 - +t) > tolerance) throw new Error("expired"); const expected = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(`${t}.${payload}`).digest("hex"); if (!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expected), Buffer.from(sig))) throw new Error("bad signature"); } Copy Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler. ON THIS PAGE Event types Verifying signatures Retries

Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Create(&weave.ChargeParams{Amount: 2000, Currency: "usd", PaymentMethod: "pm_card_visa"}) Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Capture("ch_3OZ9aB", &weave.CaptureParams{Amount: 1500}) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Refund("ch_3OZ9aB", &weave.RefundParams{Amount: 500}) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.List(&weave.ChargeListParams{Customer: "cus_abc", Limit: 10}) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. Recompute the HMAC over "<t>.<body>" using your webhook signing secret and constant-time compare. CURL PYTHON NODE GO func verify(payload, header, secret string) error { parts := strings.Split(header, ",") var ts, sig string for _, p := range parts { kv := strings.SplitN(p, "=", 2) if kv[0] == "t" { ts = kv[1] }; if kv[0] == "v1" { sig = kv[1] } } h := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret)) h.Write([]byte(ts + "." + payload)) if hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)) != sig { return errors.New("bad signature") } return nil } Copy Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler. ON THIS PAGE Event types Verifying signatures Retries

observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. observation.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO from weave import Weave client = Weave("sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") charge = client.charges.create( amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa", description="UXBench demo charge", ) print(charge.id, charge.status) Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client = Weave(api_key="sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") Copy Idempotency Every state-changing request accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. Pagination List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. has_more tells you when you've reached the end; next_cursor is the opaque token for the next page. Errors WeaveAPI returns conventional HTTP status codes plus a structured error object with type, code, and message. Full list → Popular guides Charges API → Create, capture, list, refund. Customers API → Save methods, manage profiles. Webhooks → Listen for events, sign requests. Error reference → 25+ error codes with hints. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. Recent (last 3)

observation.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url currency_not_supported 400 Currency not enabled on account Enable currency in dashboard amount_too_small 400 Below minimum charge amount Increase amount (min $0.50 USD) amount_too_large 400 Above per-transaction maximum Split the charge missing_required_param 400 Required parameter omitted Check the error param invalid_param 400 Parameter value was invalid See param and message resource_missing 404 No such resource Check the ID resource_already_exists 409 Duplicate idempotency key with different params Use a new idempotency key authentication_required 401 Missing or invalid API key Send Authorization: Bearer sk_… permission_denied 403 API key lacks scope Grant scope in dashboard rate_limited 429 Too many requests Back off; respect Retry-After account_inactive 403 Account is closed or suspended Contact support refund_too_large 400 Refund exceeds refundable amount Check amount_refunded charge_already_captured 400 Charge was already captured No action needed charge_already_refunded 400 Charge fully refunded No action needed customer_max_payment_methods 400 Cannot attach more methods (limit 25) Detach unused methods idempotency_key_in_use 409 Key in use for in-flight request Wait and retry the same key invalid_webhook_signature 400 Webhook HMAC didn't match Check signing secret service_unavailable 503 Temporary outage Retry with backoff; check status page

observation.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO from weave import Weave client = Weave("sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") charge = client.charges.create( amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa", description="UXBench demo charge", ) print(charge.id, charge.status) Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client = Weave(api_key="sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") Copy Idempotency Every state-changing request accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. Pagination List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. has_more tells you when you've reached the end; next_cursor is the opaque token for the next page. Errors WeaveAPI returns conventional HTTP status codes plus a structured error object with type, code, and message. Full list → Popular guides Charges API → Create, capture, list, refund. Customers API → Save methods, manage profiles. Webhooks → Listen for events, sign requests. Error reference → 25+ error codes with hints. observation.title: Charges — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.create(amount=2000, currency="usd", payment_method="pm_card_visa") Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.capture("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=1500) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.refund("ch_3OZ9aB", amount=500) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.charges.list(customer="cus_abc", limit=10) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Create(&weave.ChargeParams{Amount: 2000, Currency: "usd", PaymentMethod: "pm_card_visa"}) Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Capture("ch_3OZ9aB", &weave.CaptureParams{Amount: 1500}) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Refund("ch_3OZ9aB", &weave.RefundParams{Amount: 500}) Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.List(&weave.ChargeListParams{Customer: "cus_abc", Limit: 10}) Copy TRY CREATE CHARGE POST /v1/charges AMOUNT CURRENCY PAYMENT_METHOD Send → Response Click "Send" to see a mocked response. observation.visible_text: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Charges Use the Charges API to capture value from a payment method. A charge is the most atomic state change in WeaveAPI: money moved from your customer to you. The Charge object ATTRIBUTE TYPE DESCRIPTION id string Unique identifier, ch_… object string Always "charge" amount integer Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD) currency string ISO 4217 code, lowercase customer string Customer ID, or null for guest charges status enum pending · succeeded · failed · refunded captured boolean Whether funds have been captured. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Create(&weave.ChargeParams{Amount: 2000, Currency: "usd", PaymentMethod: "pm_card_visa"}) Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Retrieve("ch_3OZ9aB") Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO client.Charges.Capture("ch_3OZ9aB", &weave.CaptureParams{Amount: 1500}) Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. CURL PYTHON NODE GO import "github.com/weaveapi/weave-go" client := weave.New("sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc") charge, err := client.Charges.Create(&weave.ChargeParams{ Amount: 2000, Currency: "usd", PaymentMethod: "pm_card_visa", Description: "UXBench demo charge", }) Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Retry safely: a retry with the same key returns the original response, even if your client retried after a timeout. False after a successful authorize without capture. refunded boolean True if fully refunded amount_refunded integer Sum of refunds in smallest currency unit payment_method string Payment method ID, pm_… description string Free-form description (≤500 chars) metadata object Up to 50 user-supplied key-value pairs statement_descriptor string Up to 22 chars; shown on the buyer's statement failure_code string Set when status === "failed" failure_message string Human-readable failure reason receipt_url string Hosted receipt URL after successful capture created integer Unix timestamp livemode boolean false when using test keys Create a charge POST /v1/charges PARAMETERS amount integer · required Smallest currency unit currency string · required usd · eur · gbp · jpy payment_method string · required Payment method ID customer string · optional Attach this charge to a customer capture boolean · optional If false, only authorize description string · optional Internal description metadata object · optional Up to 50 keys EXAMPLE CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy RETURNS { "id": "ch_3OZ9aB1k0p8q2X", "object": "charge", "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd", "customer": null, "status": "succeeded", "captured": true, "payment_method": "pm_card_visa", "description": "UXBench demo charge", "receipt_url": "https://pay.weave.dev/receipts/ch_3OZ9aB", "created": 1747000000, "livemode": false } Retrieve a charge GET /v1/charges/{id} Returns the charge object for the given ID. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy Capture a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/capture Captures a previously authorized but uncaptured charge. Optionally specify an amount to capture less than the original authorization. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/capture -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=1500 Copy Refund a charge POST /v1/charges/{id}/refund Issue a full or partial refund. Refunds settle back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges/ch_3OZ9aB/refund -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" -d amount=500 Copy List charges GET /v1/charges Optional filters: customer, status, created[gte], limit (1–100, default 25). CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl "https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges?customer=cus_abc&limit=10" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…" Copy

observation.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
observation.visible_text: 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. Recompute the HMAC over "<t>.<body>" using your webhook signing secret and constant-time compare. CURL PYTHON NODE GO # verify via openssl + sha256 echo -n "$timestamp.$body" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$WEBHOOK_SECRET" Copy Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler.

observation.visible_text: 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.paid Invoice transitioned to paid invoice.payment_failed Charge attempt failed for invoice subscription.created New subscription subscription.updated Plan / quantity / proration change subscription.canceled Subscription ended Verifying signatures Each webhook includes a WeaveAPI-Signature header: t=<unix-ts>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>. Recompute the HMAC over "<t>.<body>" using your webhook signing secret and constant-time compare. CURL PYTHON NODE GO import hmac, hashlib, time def verify(payload, header, secret, tolerance=300): ts, sig = [p.split("=")[1] for p in header.split(",")] if abs(time.time() - int(ts)) > tolerance: raise ValueError("expired") expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), f"{ts}.{payload}".encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest() if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, sig): raise ValueError("bad signature") Copy Retries We retry non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours (max 24 attempts). Respond with 200 as soon as the event is enqueued — don't block on heavy work in the request handler.
